stories.title: Woman in critical condition after struck by car in Midvale
stories.summary: A woman is in the hospital in critical condition after being hit by a car in Midvale Monday night.

stories.title: Your flight was canceled. Who pays for dinner or the hotel?
stories.summary: Nearly six million people are expected to fly this Thanksgiving. If your flight gets canceled or significantly delayed, here's what the airline owes you and what the credit card you booked with might pick up.

stories.title: Utah lawmakers eye another attempt to repeal law allowing developers to form cities
stories.summary: Rep. Tiara Auxier this week teed up another attempt to repeal a controversial development law that was a contentious election issue this year, especially in Utah's Wasatch Back.

stories.title: Utah man convicted of murder now accused of attacking officer at state prison
stories.summary: A man serving up to life in the Utah State Prison for murder is accused of attacking at Department of Corrections officer from behind.

stories.title: New federal rule ends housing aid for some families
stories.summary: Starting Dec. 14, every member of a household must be verified as a U.S. citizen or an eligible noncitizen to receive HUD housing benefits.

stories.title: Woman threatens to blow up trailer during standoff with police
stories.summary: A southern Utah woman is accused of threatening to fill her trailer with gas and ignite it if law enforcers attempted to arrest her.

stories.title: Utah board votes unanimously to certify the midterm election results
stories.summary: Utah's State Board of Canvassers voted unanimously on Monday to certify the results of the recent general election, which saw a blue wave hit Utah and break the Republicans' supermajority in the state Legislature for the first time in decades.

stories.title: Devon Dampier to honor 'cancer warriors' by wearing their designed cleats against West Virginia
stories.summary: For the family of 14-year-old Liam Watkins, those few minutes were a lifeline amid an ongoing struggle with T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma, a form of cancer most commonly found in children and young adults.

stories.title: A stunning supermoon peaks this week. Here's what to know
stories.summary: If you need a reason to gaze at the night sky this week, November's full supermoon is putting on a brilliant celestial show.

stories.title: These Utah ski resorts open this week
stories.summary: Family, friends and football typically mark the Thanksgiving holiday. But this year, you could add skiing and snowboarding.

stories.title: The KSL Vault: A window to Utah history
stories.summary: Before the internet, stories that aired on KSL were only seen once. Now, all those stories are getting a second life with the new KSL Vault on YouTube.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? Donny Osmond puts out backyard barbecue fire
stories.summary: Singer and local legend Donny Osmond helped extinguish a fire in a backyard barbecue on Sunday while on his way to his granddaughter's birthday party.
